quality.definition: standard or degree of excellence of something
quality.ex: The quality of this fabric is excellent.
quality.mnemonic: quality – 'kis quality ka maal hai?' matlab kaisa achha hai

quiescent.ex: The volcano remained quiescent for centuries.
quiescent.mnemonic: quiescent – 'quiet-scent', shaant aur nishkriya pada hua

quell.definition: suppress or put an end to
quell.ex: Troops were sent to quell the riot.
quell.mnemonic: quell – 'kill' jaisa lagta hai, police ne danga kill/dabaa diya

query.ex: I sent a query to the support team.
query.mnemonic: query – computer mein search ka sawaal, quer=poochna

quandary.ex: She was in a quandary about which job to accept.
quandary.mnemonic: quandary – kaun sa raasta? confusion mein phasa banda

quit.definition: to leave or stop doing something
quit.ex: She decided to quit her job.
quit.mnemonic: quit – job chhod do, free ho jao

qualified.ex: She is highly qualified for this teaching post.
qualified.mnemonic: qualified – quality wala banda, job ke liye fit

queer.ex: He had a queer feeling about the house.

quiet.mnemonic: quiet – kya-yet? chup raho, koi awaaz nahi

questions.definition: sentences asking for information; matters to resolve
questions.ex: The teacher answered all the students' questions.
questions.mnemonic: questions – quest (khoj) me answer dhundo, sawal

queen.ex: The queen addressed the nation on television.
queen.mnemonic: queen – rani, raja ki patni ya shaasak

quenched.ex: She quenched her thirst with cold water.
quenched.mnemonic: quenched – thanda paani se pyaas bujh gayi

quaint.ex: They stayed in a quaint little cottage by the sea.
quaint.mnemonic: quaint – purane zamane ka pyaara sa gaon, cute aur alag

quicken.ex: She quickened her pace to catch the bus.

queer pitch.definition: a strange or unfair situation to deal with
queer pitch.ex: The new rules made a queer pitch for the cricket team.

queer somebody's pitch.definition: to spoil someone's plan or chance
queer somebody's pitch.ex: Rahul's idea queered Priya's pitch for the school competition.

quay.definition: a landing place for ships; wharf
quay.ex: The boat was tied up at the quay.
quay.mnemonic: quay – 'key' bola jaata, jahaaz ke ghat pe khada

quiver.definition: to shake with a slight rapid motion
quiver.ex: Her lips began to quiver with emotion.

quake.definition: to shake or tremble, often from fear
quake.ex: The ground began to quake during the earthquake.
quake.mnemonic: quake – earthquake mein zameen kaanpti hai

quorum.definition: minimum members needed for valid meeting
quorum.ex: The meeting was cancelled for lack of a quorum.
quorum.mnemonic: quorum – meeting valid hone ka minimum count

quadrangle.definition: four-sided courtyard enclosed by buildings; a quadrilateral
quadrangle.ex: Students gathered in the college quadrangle after class.
quadrangle.mnemonic: quadrangle – quad (chaar) angle wala aangan, college ka square courtyard

quadruped.mnemonic: quad bike ke chaar pahiye, quadruped ke chaar pair

quinton.definition: a boy's name, also an old string instrument
quinton.bn: একটি ছেলের নাম বা পুরোনো বাদ্যযন্ত্র
quinton.ex: Quinton scored the highest marks in the class test.

quintessential.definition: most perfect example of a quality
quintessential.ex: He is the quintessential English gentleman.
quintessential.mnemonic: quintessential – fifth essence, sabse perfect example

quarter.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
quarter.mnemonic: quarter – char hisse mein se ek quarter

quotient.definition: result of dividing one number by another
quotient.ex: Divide sixty by five to get the quotient.
quotient.mnemonic: quotient – 'quotation' nahi, bhaag ka answer, IQ ka Q

questionaire.definition: wrong spelling of questionnaire (a form with questions)
questionaire.ex: The teacher said the questionaire has ten questions.

quever.definition: not a real word, likely typo of quaver
quever.bn: সঠিক শব্দ নয়, quaver-এর ভুল বানান
quever.ex: The teacher said 'quever' is not a proper word.

questionnaire.definition: set of printed questions for survey
questionnaire.ex: Please fill out this questionnaire before the interview.
questionnaire.mnemonic: questionnaire – question ka naala, ek ke baad ek sawaal
